question: Who became the first woman officer to join Army Aviation Corps as Combat Aviator after the successful completion of training in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Captain Abhilasha Barak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Captain Abhilasha Barak** is the** first woman officer** to join the **Army Aviation Corps as a Combat Aviator**.
 
• She achieved this milestone after successfully completing her training in **May 2022**.
 
• Her accomplishment represents a **significant step** in the increasing participation of **women in the Indian armed forces**.
 
• This achievement highlights the progress in creating **more equal opportunities for women** in sectors historically dominated by men, such as the military.
 
• It also demonstrates the **readiness and capability of women** to take on challenging roles in areas like **combat aviation**.
 
• This accomplishment will certainly** inspire more women **to consider careers in the military and other related fields.
